name: Andy Byrne
current_role: Co-founder and former CEO of Clari (merged with Salesloft in Dec 2025; Steve Cox named CEO of combined company). Current post-merger role not publicly confirmed.
profile: Silicon Valley sales/product executive who co-founded revenue-forecasting SaaS company Clari in 2013 with Venkat Rangan and led it as CEO to a ~$3B valuation. Earlier founded Timestock and was on the founding exec team at Clearwell Systems (acquired by Symantec). Clari merged with Vista-backed Salesloft, a deal announced Aug 2025 and closed Dec 2025.
interesting_fact: Clari and Salesloft announced a 'merger of equals' in August 2025 to create an AI revenue platform; Byrne was originally slated to lead the combined company.
deep_cut_fact: Grew up around Mountain View, where his father leased office space to tech startups; he says dinner-table stories about companies like Fairchild Semiconductor made him love 'the idea that you could create something from nothing.' He practices Qi Gong and has a family motto 'DPA' (Dream. Plan. Act.).
notes: Post-merger role unclear (Steve Cox became CEO at close per Business Wire). No published press email found on Salesloft/Clari newsrooms; best route likely LinkedIn or via Sequoia network. TechCrunch 2014 quoted him: Clari was his 'company number-four with Sequoia.'

name: David Sehyuk Park
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Information Officer, Moloco (Redwood City, CA)
profile: Korean-born engineer who co-founded machine-learning ad-tech company Moloco in 2013 with CEO Ikkjin Ahn after ~6 years at Oracle on cloud/virtualization (Nimbula) teams. As CIO he leads Moloco's largest global team of ML engineers, data scientists and data engineers behind its ML ad platform. BS in CS from Seoul National University; graduate studies at Stanford.
interesting_fact: Before Oracle he did graduate work at Stanford in CS/machine learning; Moloco grew into a ~$2B-valued ML performance-advertising company serving mobile apps, retail media and streaming.
deep_cut_fact: Per co-founder Ikkjin Ahn (2021 ZDNet Korea interview), Park did his master's under Andrew Ng at Stanford, was Ahn's junior by three years in SNU computer science, swept International Olympiad in Informatics medals as a youth, and had tried founding startups several times before Moloco.
notes: Low public profile; Ahn is the main spokesperson. Moloco HQ moved to Redwood City. Route via Moloco PR (pr@moloco.com).

name: Elia Wallen
current_role: Founder and CEO, Engine (formerly Hotel Engine), Denver, Colorado
profile: Denver entrepreneur who founded corporate-housing firm Travelers Haven in 2008, then spun its hotel-booking side into Hotel Engine (independent in 2018). Rebranded Engine in 2024 after a Series C (~$140M), it now books hotels, flights and cars for businesses and is valued around $2B. Wallen left the Travelers Haven CEO role in 2020 to run Engine full time.
interesting_fact: Engine grew out of Travelers Haven customers asking for help booking hotels; Wallen was named ColoradoBiz Magazine's CEO of the Year in December 2024.
deep_cut_fact: In June 2017, long before the unicorn round, EY named Wallen an Entrepreneur Of The Year award winner (hospitality, Mountain Desert region) at a gala at the Denver Center for the Performing Arts; Travelers Haven had placed 20,000+ traveling professionals in 2016 alone.
notes: Writes occasional Inc. columns (e.g., Nov 2025) on company-building lessons. Engine press room is the best route.
